content_contract: contracts/world-slice-v1.json; layouts/inputs/expectations only, never execution reports. Normal loops start from real fresh profile; boundary snapshots allowed only for negative tests.

layout.coordinate_system: orthographic ground plane; x right/y down; rect x/y are centers, actor x/y is foot point; visual three-quarter view does not change collision coordinates

customer_paths.rule: entrance → (1160, seat.y) → seat.anchor, reverse on leaving; NPCs do not block player or one another; visible path uses actual customer state, not decorative sales text.

configuration.night_rules: Generate budgets23..30 once per order in listed wave/order sequence after supply, persist RNG/queues. Day2 retain counts/arrival; replace w1c03 with meal+trail_light and w3c04 with meal+celebration, publicly forecast; rare orders optional, no progress lock.
first_loop: walk to waiting seat and serve one OR put at pass for real floating dispatch
observe paid transaction and customer reaction
negative_interactions: opposite side of solid prep table
2000 world_input setters leave persisted requests/economic ledger unchanged
client supplied serve amounts rejected/ignored, never used for payment

manual_delivery_cases.rules: Use real standard floating_pie pricing. Low budgets11..14 are explicit boundary snapshots, not changes to normal23..30 generation. Call real serve/auto schedule then advance; expected values are not reports. Save before commit and after tip, reload and replay same/new request IDs; amount remains frozen and only one sale/tip can commit per order/wave.

steps: Create actual world profile; walk spawn→pantry→prep→pass→all seats→shop-exit→vendor→garden-gate with real held input/advance.
Test all colliders/corners/diagonal speed, near56/far56.01/occluded/wrong-region targets; compare equal frame partitions.
outcomes: All working anchors reachable with radius12, no collision teleport. Core position/facing and camera follow; distant/occluded intents fail atomically.

steps: Run configuration.first_loop from untouched starter state through spatial commands; no free money, fake stock or direct craft shortcut.
Track each ingredient/output UID, cost, job timer, seat/order, reservation and paid ledger event.

For hand serve inspect core quote/preference, verify no cash at reservation then exactly next50ms step commits base/tip/total and customer reaction; automatic branch remains valid and receives no tip.
outcomes: First actual sale has matching customer reaction; world take/put/cook/serve are required and observable. Merely opening books or drawing a walking actor cannot pass.

steps: For all seeds and both price_tiers, run quick_service fresh batches through pass and hot_meals batches with cauldron/held leftovers from normal startup. Use automatic service/no tips for the required normal economy branches.
Finish three waves and next_day; choose affordable growth with actual dish revenue and next-night basic supplies. Also run without expedition.
outcomes: Both routes behave differently, no softlock/recovery dependence. Record cash/ingredients/manual trips/service outcomes; old quality economic projections are not reused as proof. Neither normal route relies on optional tips to pass.

steps: Run all configuration.negative_interactions including cold stew/wrong budget, full carry/station/output, raw/dish mix and stale order.
Save during cooking and delivery, replay request IDs and first-loaded held key; cross-check exact UID/cost/reservation/customer state.
Execute configuration.manual_delivery_cases; compare quoted/reserved/committed base_price, tip, paid_total and actual cash delta.
Replay served order with same and new request IDs, including pre50ms and postcommit reload; ensure auto scheduler cannot double-reserve manual UID/order and no second tip per wave.
Send2000 world_input setters without interactions; saved requests and economic ledger remain byte-equivalent while only held axes may change.
outcomes: Failures preserve complete state; no duplicated items or income. Paused/loaded state does not complete jobs/delivery from wall time.
Manual next-step payment is exclusive; budget-fallback/auto/nonpreferred tips0, eligible tip2 once, base-unaffordable no state change. Frozen quote survives save and ledger total balances.

steps: From legitimate first-night settled snapshots, branch into shelf or field_kit, next_day activate.
Repeat same physical cooking sequence with/without shelf, count manual ready→pass carrying trips; fan branch walks lane gate and uses actual new weapon in reused garden.
outcomes: Relay reduces repeated dish hauling and creates no food/cash; blocked menu leaves output at station. Fan changes actual combat; no forced double-purchase prohibition.

steps: At every save boundary fork continuous/save/restart with identical later inputs, test map/profile/version corruption and same-profile valid backup.

Run old r2/rain-night/three-day and new launchers only against isolated controlled test copies. Hash guards cover inactive old saves, controlled copies and immutable packages; never read/restore/delete active human r2 save files or require their hashes to remain fixed. Verify new world itself makes no access to old paths.
outcomes: Position/facing/region/carry/jobs/customer/order/meal/return/RNG are equal apart from explicitly cleared held input. Guarded inactive artifacts/copies untouched; active human saving remains allowed. New world never accesses old player saves; no hidden migration.

steps: With render lock and Godot real Main, inject mouse/keyboard, touch, pad InputEvents to play first loop and a full night plus growth; save/quit/restart process.
Capture movement, camera boundary, hands/table, cooking, real customer/flight/income, narrow/fullscreen; record times without enforcing waiting.
In player package with tests/fixtures absent, render geometry from Core and show hand-preference/quote before F, immediate paid response after service step; no runtime fixture reads.
outcomes: Actual UI path reaches complete business loop; no core.command or Button.pressed bypass. Motion probe is labeled separate and cannot satisfy sale case.

steps: User or 咩咩 freely tries new candidate; record actual actions and quoted feedback on moving/handling/cooking/serving and desire to continue.
outcomes: Negative r2 entry feedback retained; new untested periods stay untested. If still dull or excessive hauling, fail experience and fix before expanding.
